decision: Route is LIVE and working, so the vendors hero gets ONE gold primary CTA 'Vendor Application' (NOT 'Register as a vendor', per NOS Design ruling). The href is /national-show/vendors/apply, NOT /vendors/register: /register is the invitation-gated second step (it needs an emailed code from an approved application) and the form it serves offers an unapproved visitor no path, i.e. a dead end for everyone who has not already applied. Recommendation to NOS Design / Brad. If NOS Design wants the literal /vendors/register href, change cta.href below and the dev mirrors it; the check is otherwise unchanged.
